headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2026, MJF vs. Mark Briscoe went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.08 ? an excellent showing. With his knee already hanging by a thread from a title defense against Rush weeks earlier, MJF defended the AEW World Championship against Mark Briscoe in the show's opening match.

Looking back to 2022, when YOSHI-HASHI made their AEW debut, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.06 ? a solid showing. Teaming with YOSHI-HASHI as Bishamon, Goto pushed the Young Bucks to the limit before the champions closed it out with the Meltzer Driver.

That Wednesday in 2020, Hikaru Shida vs. Penelope Ford put the AEW Women's World Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.98 ? a match that delivered. For Penelope Ford, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2026, the AEW TBS Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Hikaru Shida vs. Harley Cameron vs. Kris Statlander vs. Maika vs. Persephone vs. Queen Aminata battled it out in a Survival of the Fittest match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.65 ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. For Maika, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. In the first-ever Survival of the Fittest match, held for the TBS Title Willow Nightingale had to vacate through injury, a furious Persephone struck a locked-in Kris Statlander with the belt out of spite ? handing the win, and the vacant championship, to Hikaru Shida.
That Wednesday in 2020, MJF & Wardlow made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a strong outing.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Rush made their AEW debut in a Royal Rampage match against Brody King vs. Adam Page vs. Dante Martin vs. Darby Allin vs. Dustin Rhodes vs. Frankie Kazarian vs. Keith Lee vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Matt Hardy vs. Max Caster vs. Penta Oscuro vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Ricky Starks vs. Swerve Strickland vs. The Butcher vs. The Blade vs. Tony Nese, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.56.
